description: This file defines the FP_eventsController class, which manages various event-related actions in the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for marking attendance and invitations, adding contacts/leads to events, and sending invitation emails, indicating its central role in event management within the module.

classes.name: FP_eventsController
classes.description: Controller class for managing events, including RSVP handling, attendee updates, contact/list management, and email invitations.

methods.name: action_markasinvited
methods.description: Marks specified contacts, leads, and prospects as invited for an event, updating their invite status in the database.

methods.name: action_markasattended
methods.description: Marks specified contacts, leads, and prospects as attended for an event.

methods.name: action_markasnotattended
methods.description: Marks specified contacts, leads, and prospects as not attended.

methods.name: action_markasnotinvited
methods.description: Marks specified contacts, leads, and prospects as not invited, also resetting email response flags.

methods.name: action_markasaccepted
methods.description: Marks specified contacts, leads, and prospects as accepted invitations.

methods.name: action_markasdeclined
methods.description: Marks specified contacts, leads, and prospects as declined invitations.

methods.name: action_add_to_list
methods.description: Adds contacts, leads, or prospects to an event's relationship list based on the provided list IDs and type.

methods.name: action_sendinvitemails
methods.description: Sends invitation emails to event-related contacts, prospects, and leads that have not yet responded, updating their invite status accordingly.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Helper method to send emails using SugarPHPMailer, logs the email in the system, and returns success status.
